decision.then: the line stops before week 1 and no other row runs; the grep result is published as a findings write-up with the named-subject results beside it, and the long and alias worlds are committed as public development worlds

decision.if: the alias pilot's grep agent pools below 0.95 (Amendment 1)
decision.then: the other rows run their pilots and the line runs as frozen from launch amendment A; a gbrain pilot gap of more than 3 points behind the grep agent sends that public world's per-kind rows to gbrain's maintainers as an advisory issue, and no claim is published from the pilot

decision.if: a block reads gbrain behind the grep agent on a class
decision.then: matching the grep agent on that class becomes the first item on gbrain's improvement list, ahead of new features, with per-kind rows and exposure naming retrieval or reading; no gbrain release note claims better recall than search on that class; a second behind block in a row on the same class starts one Why-null cycle ending in keep, fix-method or a cut candidate for the project owner

decision.if: a block reads gbrain level with the grep agent on a class
decision.then: direction stays; the page shows cost per correct answer beside accuracy, and kinds where the grep agent leads become issues for gbrain's maintainers

decision.if: a block reads gbrain ahead of the grep agent on a class
decision.then: direction stays; the line's page and README say gbrain beats a grep agent on held-out questions of that class, with the interval and release

decision.if: a block reads gbrain behind a memory server on a class
decision.then: that class's per-kind rows and exposure go to gbrain's maintainers as issues, as BG1-C's did

decision.if: a block reads gbrain ahead of or level with a server, split by reader, or no measurable difference
decision.then: the block's row and per-reader rows are published and nothing else changes on that comparison

decision.if: a weekly point falls outside the previous block's interval by more than the weekly smallest detectable difference
decision.then: an advisory issue to gbrain's maintainers with the release range and the flag's simulated false-alarm rate; no release is held
